notes: Hosts are machines. The BOOX is a capture device and is not selected by hostname. Tool content syncs on its own; this file only records paths and connection status.

latex.notes: TeXstudio is the editor. LuaLaTeX and Biber come from the TeX install under it. LaTeX Workshop is not assumed.

Ubuntu apt: texlive-luatex, texlive-latex-recommended, texlive-latex-extra, texlive-fonts-recommended, texlive-bibtex-extra, texlive-lang-english, biber, latexmk. Build with the LaTeX Workshop recipe latexmk (lualatex). Times New Roman is the vault copy, not the system mscorefonts package.
